name: Developer Tools
author: Machine Hunter Workshop
description: For map makers and modders: an information panel, labels and paths drawn over the actors, the collision the engine really uses, enemies that ignore you, slow motion, memory snapshots and an event trace.

options.label: Info panel
options.help: A panel in the corner with the frame number, the actor count and the player's health. The four options below add lines to it.

options.label: Actor inspector
options.help: Marks one actor in the world and lists its position, health, AI state and path in the info panel.

options.label: Actor type numbers
options.help: The entity type number above every actor, as used in the Workshop's entity list.

options.label: Actor paths
options.help: The route each actor is following, as drawn with the Paths tool.

options.label: Target lines
options.help: A line from each actor to whatever it is currently aiming at.

options.label: Collision wireframe
options.help: Outlines what blocks movement, as the engine sees it.

options.label: Passive enemies
options.help: Enemies do not notice the player. Not remembered between launches.

options.label: Save memory snapshot
options.help: Writes the game's memory to game/logs/snapshots.

options.label: Runtime trace
options.help: Logs every shot and every point of damage to game/logs/runtime-trace.log.
